title: CSCI 538 — Puzzles for Computing
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the four primary puzzle categories (logical, maze, optimization, word) and map each to a corresponding algorithmic paradigm.
Explain how human-inspired solving strategies differ from optimal algorithmic approaches and identify when each is appropriate.
Evaluate puzzle hunt design principles by analyzing ambiguity resolution, unique solvability, and instruction-free constraints.
